# Win Totals

> **Two source classes on this page, never mixed in one claim.** *How the guide defines it*, *how the guide uses it* and every page reference are **GUIDE CONTENT**. *Working definition*, *why it matters* and any arithmetic over printed figures are **TTW DERIVED** — this library's words, supplied because the guide supplies none. ## How the guide defines it

p. 2 glosses the components: `O – Over`, `U – Under`, `O/U – Over/Under`, `PRJW'S – Projected Wins`, `PRJL'S – Projected Losses`.

## How the guide uses it

Stated three separate ways that do not always agree: a DraftKings number in every conference table for all 138 teams, a standalone Over/Under recommendation on every team page, and Makinen's feature on pp. 22–27 backing 29 of them with arguments. 27 of the 62 best bets on pp. 5–15 are also win totals.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

A market on how many games a team wins in the regular season, bet Over or Under a posted number.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

It is where the guide's ratings, schedule work and roster systems all land in a single number that can be bet.

## How bettors use it in this guide

Makinen states the loop on p. 22: work through the coaching changes, the Stability Scores, the transitional systems and the recruiting rankings, then play the schedule out by his power ratings and compare the result with the posted total. He prints his own four-year record, 57-42-2, of which 34-17-1 on Unders, and says that is why he again favours Unders.

## Where it appears

pp. 22–27 for the feature; every conference table for the posted numbers; every team page for the standalone pick.
